sn28.1:1.2: pubbaṇhasamayaṁ → pubbanhasamayaṁ (bj) | sāriputto → sārīputto (sya-all) | sāvatthiṁ → sāvatthiyaṁ (bj: sī.pavi) | Sāvatthim → S1-3 sāvatthiyaṁ (pts note)
sn28.1:1.4: ajjhogāhetvā → ajjhogahetvā (bj) | andhavanaṁ ajjhogāhetvā → andhavanam ajjhogahetvā (pts)
sn28.1:2.1: sāriputto sāyanhasamayaṁ paṭisallānā → sārīputto sāyaṇhasamayaṁ paṭisallāṇā (sya-all) | sāyanhasamayaṁ paṭisallānā → sāyaṇhasamayaṁ paṭisallāṇā (pts) | jetavanaṁ anāthapiṇḍikassa → jetavanam ānāthapiṇḍikassa (pts)
sn28.1:2.2: sāriputtaṁ → sārīputtaṁ (sya-all) | dūratova āgacchantaṁ → durato va āgacchantam (pts)
sn28.1:2.3: sāriputtaṁ → sārīputtaṁ (sya-all) | sāriputtaṁ etadavoca vippasannāni → sāriputtam etad avoca vippasannāṇi (pts)
sn28.1:3.1: vivekajaṁ pītisukhaṁ paṭhamaṁ jhānaṁ → vivekajam pītisukham pathamajjhānam (pts) | jhānaṁ → paṭhamajjhānaṁ (bj: sīmu8) | vivicceva → S1 viviccehi (pts note) | pathamajjhānam → B pathamaṁ jhānam, and further on pathamā jhānā always. Likewise in the following suttas (pts note)
sn28.1:3.3: ahaṁ paṭhamaṁ jhānaṁ → aham pathamajjhānaṁ (pts) | ahaṁ paṭhamaṁ jhānaṁ samāpannoti → aham pathamajjhānam samāpanno ti (pts) | pathamajjhānā → S1-3 -jhānaṁ, S1 having paṭhamaṁ (pts note) | ti → S1-3 omit iti (pts note)
sn28.1:3.4: ahaṅkāramamaṅkāramānānusayā → ahiṅkāramamiṅkāramānānusayā (bj) | sāriputtassa → sārīputtassa (sya-all) | panāyasmato → S1-3 tathā pahīnāyasmato (pts note)
sn28.1:3.6: paṭhamā jhānā → paṭhamajjhānā (bj) | ahaṁ paṭhamaṁ jhānaṁ → aham pathamajjhānaṁ (pts) | ahaṁ paṭhamaṁ jhānaṁ samāpannoti → aham pathamajjhānaṁ samāpanno ti (pts) | Sāvatthi → In B only (pts note)
